name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: July Week 8 - Integrated Challenge
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: A code choice between two actions.
words.example: The if/else block chose between a green light and a warning sound.

words.definition: A limit where an action changes.
words.example: The threshold separated safe readings from alert readings.

words.definition: Information that goes into a system or program.
words.example: The sensor reading was the input for the challenge.

words.definition: What a system or program produces.
words.example: The buzzer and LED were outputs from the project.

words.definition: A task that takes effort to complete.
words.example: The challenge asked the team to combine input, process, and output.

words.definition: Continuing to try when work is difficult.
words.example: Perseverance helped the group keep testing after the first failure.

words.definition: Trying something to see if it works.
words.example: Testing proved which threshold worked best.

words.definition: A change that makes something better.
words.example: The improvement made the alert easier to notice.
